notes.title: Major update 7.00. Added 12 new professions and made significant adjustments to
notes.content:
Major update 7.00. Added 12 new professions and made significant adjustments to weapon data, making weapon bonuses more important and challenging.
----
Due to extensive data modifications, version 6.00 is saved in the game directory. After each major modification, the previous version is saved in the game directory.

notes.title: Major update 6.00. Join a new level called "Battle of Nanmen Pass",
notes.content:
Major update 6.00. Join a new level called "Battle of Nanmen Pass", increase the use of common units to counter each other, enhance command skills, redo all available characters, and increase the impact of generals' organization
----
Join a new level called "Battle South Gate"
If you think your team is strong enough, you can directly attack the southern gate of the empire and attack the empire from the front.
You will face a brigade of the Imperial regular army for the first time,
The teleportation gate of this level mode is located in the northwest of the first level of the empire, and the enemy will only attack within the range, which is relatively simple.
The level entered from the challenge is the challenge mode of this level, and the enemy will launch a full-scale attack in the first round, which is relatively difficult.
My first attempt at the big map seems a bit sluggish.
----
Increase commonly used troops to counter each other (professions)
You will experience it in the first level of the Empire Line, which is why you have redone the first level of the Empire Line
Swordsmen - High Dodge - Medium damage=Swordsmen defeat Axemen, but dodging is not always so reliable
Axe Soldier - High Damage - Low Hit=Axe Soldier Conquers Spear Soldier. Its immense power is useless even if it cannot hit people, making it more suitable for dealing with those tin cans
Gunmen - high hit - medium defense=Gunmen defeat swordsmen, Gunmen defeat light cavalry, but the damage is a bit low when facing heavy armor units,
Bowmen - low damage - long range=Bowmen conquer low armor, heavy armor conquer bowmen, close combat counter bowmen, prioritize targeting fragile mages
Flying Soldier - High Damage - Low Armor=Flying Soldier Conquers Bow Soldier, Bow Soldier also Conquers Flying Soldier, High Mobility Power is more suitable for battlefield interweaving support
Better and more suitable equipment can effectively reduce this kind of incompatibility
Other uncommon special units have also made some adjustments
----
Increase command skills
Within the command range of generals with command skills, our troops will be stronger
----
Redo all available roles
Due to the addition of new skills, some adjustments were made and some initial professions of certain characters were modified
----
The impact of increasing organizational structure
The more generals in the team with command skills, the stronger the team's combat effectiveness
----
Added some new equipment
----
Because it is a large-scale update with significant changes, 5.00 will be retained in the game installation directory

notes.title: Major update 5.0, adding magic and weapon effects, and adding abnormal states.
notes.content:
Major update 5.0, adding magic and weapon effects, and adding abnormal states.
update 4.00, adding 32x2+3 challenge levels, you will face attacking enemies from multiple branches, and the field will be a plain with no danger to defend.
You can enter the challenge level from the stronghold and retreat at any time. Even if you retreat, the rewards obtained from the battle will be retained.
There are 6 teleportation gates and signposts inside the level to investigate the giant dragon slate.
The challenge level is very difficult and requires high equipment from the team, and of course, rewards are also good.
--
Increase the maximum number of troops that players can attack, with a maximum of 50, so it is best to choose to form a 50 person unit.
The minimum number of attackers, excluding auxiliary troops, is one.
--
Mengxin suggests starting with a normal difficulty level, which is already quite challenging.
Difficulties range from 1 to 10, and the attack methods and magic of enemy generals may vary at different levels of difficulty.
11-100 difficulty, only increasing numerical value.
Please refer to the instructions for each difficulty level.
--
Added some initial props
Add more new weapons and armor
Add 5 blessings from the walkers, sell them to earn coins, which will reduce the difficulty of the game. Players can use them at their discretion.
--
We have redesigned the economic system, increased the number of items dropped, and changed some equipment to post war settlement (reducing the number of times players click the mouse)
--

notes.title: Update 3.20, Tower of Light and Tower of Trial have been updated,
notes.content:
Update 3.20, Tower of Light and Tower of Trial have been updated,
The Tower of Trial drops various equipment and a large amount of gold coins, and a half price necklace drops from 100 layers,
Tower of Light drops Light equipment, Life Magic Stone, Light Magic Stone, and various weapons.

notes.title: Update 3.10 to increase the difficulty of Empire levels
notes.content:
Update 3.10 to increase the difficulty of Empire levels, with more and stronger reinforcements and better drops.
Come and experience the power of the empire. It is recommended to start the game on normal difficulty,
Prop material conservation pockets now cost 50W each, consumables, can be used once.
And limit the items that can be replicated, this item is really too strong.

notes.content:
Update 3.0- Added 20 new advanced spells, limited to sale in the stronghold store, and some levels may also drop.
Increase difficulty, some levels add reinforcements to the enemy, and some levels add rescue missions.
There will be better drops.
The first level of the empire will add 2 towers of portals

notes.title: 2.00 has been launched
notes.content:
2.00 has been launched
----------------------
A large amount of data has been modified, proficiency restrictions on the use of weapons have been added, and many weapons have been added.
Battle level 60 has been updated, and the enemy has added new equipment and dropped it even better.
Some bosses will use different weapons with different difficulty levels.
The Tower of Trials has been updated (playing at level 1 is very challenging).
Tower of Light 1-10 has been updated and dropped very well, making it even more difficult. Playing at level 1 is very challenging.
--------------------------------------
The new map and Tower of Light 10-100 are not yet completed
--------------------------------------
All tests are conducted on normal difficulty, and beginners suggest starting the game on normal difficulty.
